briefings.title: Draghi: France is Far From Becoming a Euro-Area Crisis
briefings.tldr: Former ECB President Mario Draghi dismissed fears of a French debt-driven euro area crisis while warning that global trade fragmentation requires Europe to rapidly forge new economic coalitions with partners like India and Canada.

briefings.title: SIEPR Economic Summit 2026 | Fireside Chat with Mario Draghi, former Prime Minister of Italy
briefings.channel: Stanford Institute for Economic Policy Research (SIEPR)
briefings.tldr: Mario Draghi calls for a radical overhaul of European economic policy to bridge a widening "innovation gap" with the U.S. and China, warning that while global economies have shown remarkable post-pandemic resilience, Europe faces an existential threat from high energy costs and stagnant high-tech productivity.
